reviewStandard: Only exact L-cysteine is cleared for one immutable heavy-atom connectivity call. Antimicrobial metals, autoimmunity, biofilm, calprotectin, and dietary iron-gut ecology fail material, process, organism, molecular-state, specimen, or network-scope gates and receive no prompt marker or generation call.
promotionRule: Only a literal single-model L-cysteine output matching the frozen seven-heavy-atom count, connectivity boundary, pale field, and crop-safe requirements may proceed to exact-hash review. The other five routes remain non-public scientific holds.

routeDecisions.reason: The route combines four elements, multiple ionic and material states, nanoparticles, surfaces, host phagolysosomes, and several mechanisms without choosing one composition, oxidation state, dose, organism, specimen, or assay.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by exact element and chemical/material form, composition, oxidation state, particle or surface specification, dose, exposure route, target organism and strain, specimen, assay, endpoint, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: The route spans multiple diseases, tissues, autoantigens, antibodies, immune-cell states, barriers, microbes, metals, and causal hypotheses rather than one bounded physical subject.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Choose an exact disease and stage, organ or tissue, autoantigen, immune effector and state, specimen, assay, population or model, endpoint, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: MeSH spans several microbial kingdoms and variable extracellular matrices, while the route further combines devices, gut ecology, single- and mixed-kingdom communities, mineralization, and multiple metals.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Choose exact organism or defined community, strain, growth surface or tissue, matrix composition, developmental stage, spatial scale, specimen preparation, imaging modality, metal state, and claim boundary.

routeDecisions.reason: The route mixes heterodimer language, calcium-dependent heterotetramerization, several metal-bound states, neutrophil biology, fecal biomarker measurement, and multiple diseases. The available 1XK4 structure is one mutated calcium-bound human heterotetramer, not a universal state or assay signal.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Select exact species, S100A8/A9 sequences, mutation state, oligomer, calcium and transition-metal occupancy, structure accession, compartment, specimen or assay, units, and claim scope.

routeDecisions.reason: The route combines heme and non-heme iron, foods and supplements, absorption and luminal gradients, host transport, siderophores, many taxa, and context-dependent ecological outcomes.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define exact iron form and dose, food or formulation, compartment, time point, host population or model, microbial community, specimen and assay, measured gradient, outcome, and evidence tier.
